prompt: I knocked on my neighbor's door to ___ him that his loud bird wakes me up at six every morning.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу идет прямое дополнение (him), обозначающее собеседника.

prompt: The shop owner stepped outside to ___ to the delivery driver about blocking the crosswalk during rush hour.
explanation_ru: Speak to someone about something используется для серьезного разговора с кем-либо; остальные глаголы (say, tell, explain) не сочетаются напрямую с предлогом to в таком значении.

prompt: While decorating cinnamon buns, we ___ about our weekend plans and favorite childhood sweets.
explanation_ru: Talk about something передает непринужденную дружескую беседу на разные темы.

prompt: The driver apologized and ___ the officer that his navigation app had sent him down the one-way street.
explanation_ru: Tell используется с указанием адресата без предлога (told the officer that...).

prompt: As they collected plastic bottles along the shore, the volunteers ___ about sea turtles and weekend litter.
explanation_ru: Для описания неформального общения во время совместного дела лучше всего подходит talk about.

prompt: Mom ___ us to take out the recycling before she got home, so stop arguing whose turn it is.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell someone to do something используется для передачи просьбы или указания.

prompt: The production assistant brought a box of pastries to ___ thank you to the shopkeeper for moving his noisy van during filming.
explanation_ru: Выражение благодарности передается устойчивым сочетанием say thank you (to someone).

prompt: While slicing salmon for the rolls, the chef ___ casually with the guest about last night's rainy baseball game.
explanation_ru: Talk with someone about something подчеркивает легкую, непринужденную беседу.

prompt: We bumped into each other after five years and ___ about our jobs and pets while waiting for our drinks.
explanation_ru: Talk about используется, когда люди делятся новостями и болтают при встрече.

prompt: While waiting for their appointments, the retired postman ___ the student stories about his worst childhood dentist visits.
explanation_ru: Рассказывать истории — это устойчивое сочетание tell stories (tell someone stories).

prompt: The restorers ___ politely about whether to preserve the faded 18th-century wall drawing found behind the wardrobe.
explanation_ru: Speak about уместно в более серьезном, профессиональном обсуждении исторической находки, хотя в речи также возможен вариант talked about.

prompt: When the cowbells woke them at dawn, she ___ that pitching the tent in the dark had been his idea.
explanation_ru: Глагол say используется перед придаточным с that, когда собеседник не указан сразу после глагола.

prompt: Arriving twenty minutes early, the candidate ___ with the barista, unaware that he was actually the hiring manager.
explanation_ru: Talk with someone означает вести светскую беседу или болтать с кем-либо.

prompt: Looking at the old street photo, she couldn't ___ for sure whether the man in the background was their former neighbor.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell в сочетании can't tell означает «не мочь определить / понять наверняка».

prompt: During the intermission, the usher said the guest that she had left her glasses on the seat.
answer: During the intermission, the usher told the guest that she had left her glasses on the seat.
accepted_answers: During the intermission, the usher told the guest that she had left her glasses on the seat.
During the intermission, the usher said to the guest that she had left her glasses on the seat.
explanation_ru: После say нельзя ставить прямое дополнение (the guest) без предлога to; правильно использовать told the guest.

prompt: Over lunch, the teachers talked about their summer holiday plans while watching students queue for pizza.
answer: Over lunch, the teachers talked about their summer holiday plans while watching students queue for pizza.
accepted_answers: Over lunch, the teachers talked about their summer holiday plans while watching students queue for pizza.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: talked about правильно передает непринужденный разговор о планах.

prompt: The scientists spoke whether a sudden storm was coming or a sea bird had landed on the wind meter.
answer: The scientists talked about whether a sudden storm was coming or a sea bird had landed on the wind meter.
accepted_answers: The scientists talked about whether a sudden storm was coming or a sea bird had landed on the wind meter.
The scientists spoke about whether a sudden storm was coming or a sea bird had landed on the wind meter.
explanation_ru: После глаголов speak и talk перед темой обсуждения необходим предлог about.

prompt: The customer told that the warranty covered a cracked screen, but the clerk pointed to the receipt.
answer: The customer said that the warranty covered a cracked screen, but the clerk pointed to the receipt.
accepted_answers: The customer said that the warranty covered a cracked screen, but the clerk pointed to the receipt.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует указания собеседника; без него перед придаточным с that используется said.

prompt: After losing the match, the doubles partners spoke quietly by the net about who should have covered the back line.
answer: After losing the match, the doubles partners spoke quietly by the net about who should have covered the back line.
accepted_answers: After losing the match, the doubles partners spoke quietly by the net about who should have covered the back line.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: spoke quietly ... about грамматически верно и уместно в ситуации обсуждения игры.

prompt: I am writing to tell thank you to the seller for packing this vintage camera so carefully and adding extra batteries.
answer: I am writing to say thank you to the seller for packing this vintage camera so carefully and adding extra batteries.
accepted_answers: I am writing to say thank you to the seller for packing this vintage camera so carefully and adding extra batteries.
explanation_ru: Поблагодарить кого-либо по-английски — say thank you to someone, а не tell thank you.

prompt: Standing by the ferry railing, the passengers talked about how their pets handle sea travel.
answer: Standing by the ferry railing, the passengers talked about how their pets handle sea travel.
accepted_answers: Standing by the ferry railing, the passengers talked about how their pets handle sea travel.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: talked about естественно звучит для беседы попутчиков.

prompt: The woman stopped him and said him that their red suitcases were identical except for the luggage tags.
answer: The woman stopped him and told him that their red suitcases were identical except for the luggage tags.
accepted_answers: The woman stopped him and told him that their red suitcases were identical except for the luggage tags.
The woman stopped him and said to him that their red suitcases were identical except for the luggage tags.
explanation_ru: Сочетание said him неверно; с прямым дополнением him нужно использовать told him.

prompt: Outside the oral exam room, the nervous students talked their weekend plans to stay calm.
answer: Outside the oral exam room, the nervous students talked about their weekend plans to stay calm.
accepted_answers: Outside the oral exam room, the nervous students talked about their weekend plans to stay calm.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk непереходный: перед темой разговора (their weekend plans) нужен предлог about.

prompt: The farmer complains that visitors walked into the crops because nobody read his wooden sign.
options: The farmer talked visitors about ignoring his wooden sign.
The farmer told that visitors had ignored his wooden sign and walked into the crops.
The farmer spoke visitors that they had ignored his wooden sign.
The farmer said that visitors had ignored his wooden sign and walked into the crops.
explanation_ru: Только первый вариант верен: say используется перед that без прямого дополнения, а tell, speak и talk требуют другого управления.

prompt: Two coworkers stand by the coffee machine and complain politely about the rainy weather and the slow printer.
options: They stood by the coffee machine and said the rainy weather and the slow printer.
They stood by the coffee machine and told about the rainy weather and the slow printer.
They stood by the coffee machine and talked about the rainy weather and the slow printer.
They stood by the coffee machine and spoke the rainy weather and the slow printer.
explanation_ru: Болтать на повседневные темы у кофемашины — это talked about.

prompt: She posts a thank-you message online to the kind family who finally adopted an old one-eyed cat.
options: She posted a message to say thank you to the kind family who adopted the old cat.
She posted a message to tell thank you to the kind family who adopted the old cat.
She posted a message to speak thank you to the kind family who adopted the old cat.
She posted a message to talk thank you to the kind family who adopted the old cat.
explanation_ru: Поблагодарить кого-либо выражается фразой say thank you to someone.

prompt: The writer posts a short review thanking the cafe owners for staying open when the power went out.
options: In her review, she spoke the cafe owners thank you for staying open when the power went out.
In her review, she told thank you to the cafe owners for staying open when the power went out.
In her review, she said thank you to the cafe owners for staying open when the power went out.
In her review, she talked thank you to the cafe owners for staying open when the power went out.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение благодарности строится только с глаголом say: say thank you to.

prompt: In a short group email, she thanks readers for sending photos of their bread made with her guide.
options: In her email, she told her readers thank you for sending photos of their bread.
In her email, she said thank you to her readers for sending photos of their bread.
In her email, she talked her readers thank you for sending photos of their bread.
In her email, she spoke thank you to her readers for sending photos of their bread.
explanation_ru: Выражение благодарности требует глагола say: said thank you to her readers.

prompt: The owner calls the police after finding an open back window, only to discover her own cat knocked over a display tray. She apologizes for the false alarm.
options: She called the police back and said them that her own cat had caused the mess.
She called the police back and spoke them that her own cat had caused the mess.
She called the police back and told them that her own cat had caused the mess.
She called the police back and talked them that her own cat had caused the mess.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу идет местоимение them (told them that...), тогда как остальные глаголы так не употребляются.

prompt: They discuss whether to fix a broken model rocket before a group of curious young children arrives.
options: He told her to fix the broken model rocket before the children arrived.
He spoke her to fix the broken model rocket before the children arrived.
He said her to fix the broken model rocket before the children arrived.
He talked her to fix the broken model rocket before the children arrived.
explanation_ru: Модель tell someone to do something используется для выражения просьбы или указания.

prompt: My neighbor (said / told) me that it was my turn to trim the tall hedge between our houses.
explanation_ru: После глагола стоит прямое дополнение me без предлога, поэтому нужен глагол told.

prompt: While waiting for the red recording light to turn off, the sound workers (said / talked) quietly about the dry shells used for horse sounds.
explanation_ru: Глагол talked с предлогом about обозначает тихую беседу на определенную тему.

prompt: The receptionist wrote an email to (say / tell) sorry for packing a meat lunch instead of a vegetarian box.
explanation_ru: Извиниться по-английски — это устойчивое сочетание say sorry.

prompt: You (said / told) that you would bring the board games and candles for the New Year's Eve party!
explanation_ru: Собеседник после глагола не указан, поэтому перед придаточным с that используется said.

prompt: The guest sent an email to (say / tell) thank you to the clinic worker for helping his sore neck after the flight.
explanation_ru: Выражение благодарности строится с глаголом say: say thank you to someone.
